title: Alts Need Better Communication: Clearlake’s Feliciano
summary:
Clearlake Capital Co-founder José E. Feliciano speaks with Dani Burger on Bloomberg Deals about its new services for wealthy clients. He also discusses investments in sports teams and predicts at least a dozen trillion-dollar companies will come out of the AI cycle. 

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: What’s Next for Anthropic’s Mega-IPO: Five Things to Watch
summary: Anthropic PBC is in the home stretch for its initial public offering, which including the $26 billion private placement is poised to top SpaceX’s record. The deal could raise up to $90.4 billion for the company and its co-founders when it prices on Nov. 18, cementing the first listing for a frontier AI model maker.

title: Observing Distortions in the AI Market: Sixth Street's Alan Waxman
summary: On "Bloomberg Deals", Sixth Street co-founder, CEO and co-CIO Alan Waxman talks with Dani Burger. They discuss the AI investment cycle, credit markets and sports investments. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cinco gráficos que muestran la enorme relevancia de Nvidia
summary: Nvidia llegó a acercarse a una valoración de US$6 billones. Ahora, el escándalo de Jensen Huang ha golpeado sus acciones y expuesto un problema que inquieta a los inversionistas: no hay un sucesor claro.

title: Nvidia's Future Rests Squarely on Shoulders of CEO Huang
summary: Nvidia Corp.’s investigation of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy is raising questions about the company’s future and sending its stock into a tailspin. If he leaves, can the company survive? That's a question many on Wall Street are trying to answer. Bloomberg's Ryan Vlastelica reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: UK’s Healey Promises to Avoid US-Style Data Center Free-for-All
summary: The UK will not allow the sort of “free-for-all” on data center development that’s sparked a public and political backlash in the US, threatening to stall investment in artificial intelligence, Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey said.

title: Applied Intuition In Talks to Raise $1.5 Billion at $30 Billion Value
summary: Applied Intuition Inc., a defense contractor developing technology for autonomous vehicles, is in talks to raise at least $1.5 billion in a new funding round led by General Catalyst, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Meta’s Head of Infrastructure, Engineering to Depart in 2027
summary: Meta Platforms Inc.’s longtime infrastructure chief will leave the company in early 2027, a major leadership change as it continues to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in artificial intelligence and the data centers needed to support it.

title: CoreWeave Shares Soar After AI Computing Firm Eases Debt Fears
summary: CoreWeave Inc. shares soared after the AI computing supplier eased fears about its debt-laden business and signaled that sales growth remains strong despite the many headwinds facing the data center boom.

title: Nvidia Scandal Raises China Stakes
summary: Terry Haines, the Founder of Pangea Policy joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about how the Nvidia scandal could have consequences far beyond the company. Haines says congressional and law-enforcement investigations may take months, while the episode could strengthen calls to restrict chip sales to China. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lumentum Slips on Deal Reaction; Fossil Group Rallies on Outlook | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Shares of CoreWeave (CRWV) rallied in premarket trading after the compay eased fears about its debt-laden business during a high-stakes quarterly report, indicating that sales growth remains strong despite challenges facing the data center industry. The AI computing provider projected revenue of $13 billion to $13.3 billion this year. That exceeded its previous range of up to $13.2 billion and sailed past the $12.9 billion that Wall Street had predicted.
- Shares of Lumentum Holdings (LITE) slipped ahead of the US market open. Marvell Technology’s (MRVL) plan to double down on AI through a blockbuster $115 billion acquisition of Lumentum is getting a lukewarm early verdict from investment experts who bet on deals. 
- Shares of Fossil Group (FOSL) rallied after the company raised its full-year sales outlook after posting quarterly growth sooner than expected. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Is Playing Out Like a Greek Tragedy, Says Seaport's Goldberg
summary: Jay Goldberg, Seaport senior analyst, says Nvidia would lose its identity without CEO Jensen Huang. Goldberg says the risk of Huang being removed is significant. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Helsing Unveils AI Military Software to Challenge Palantir
summary: Helsing Gmbh, a German dronemaker, released a platform that uses artificial intelligence to help military units process data from the field more quickly, creating a new European challenger to US-based Palantir Technologies Inc.

title: Anthropic IPO Said to Be Multiple Times Oversubscribed
summary: Anthropic's IPO has drawn multiple times the orders for the shares available, according to people familiar with the matter, as demand accelerates for potentially the biggest first-time share sale ever. Bailey Lipschultz reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Elon Musk’s AI Chatbot Grok Sexualized These Teens’ Childhood Photos
summary: The images are nearly impossible to erase. Now, a growing number of victims are pushing to hold Elon Musk’s xAI accountable.

title: Nvidia Gets Rare Downgrade as Baird Raises CEO Uncertainities
summary: Wall Street sentiment toward Nvidia Corp. is starting to crack, as an investigation into Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy is sowing doubt over the artificial intelligence chipmaker’s prospects.

title: Take-Two CEO Zelnick: AI Wont Kill Gaming Jobs
summary: Take-Two Interactive Chairman & CEO Strauss Zelnick says artificial intelligence will transform the video game industry, but he doesn't believe It will lead to fewer jobs. He says technology ultimately needs to serve one goal: make great entertainment. Zelnick sits down with David Rubenstein on this week’s episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded October 19 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Take-Two’s Zelnick Traded Movies for ‘Grand Theft Auto’ Games
summary:
Take-Two Interactive Chairman & CEO Strauss Zelnick reflects on his career in entertainment, from becoming president of 20th Century Fox to leaving the movie and television business for the emerging video game industry. He also discusses how he helped transform Take-Two into one of the biggest companies in gaming. Zelnick sits down with David Rubenstein on this week’s episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded October 19 in New York. 

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Is Latest Big Swing for Take-Two CEO’s Video Game Empire
summary: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. Chief Executive Officer Strauss Zelnick wanted to run a Hollywood studio when he was a kid.

title: Nvidia Is Core Part AI-Basket of Stocks, Emanuel Says
summary: Julian Emanuel, Evercore ISI chief equity strategist and quantitative strategist, says Nvidia is a core part of their basket of AI stocks. He also expects the Anthropic IPO to go smoothly. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
